expect_revision.description: Optional autosave bundle_version expected by the caller; enforced by dispatch (Tier-1): a stale expectation on a targeted clip is rejected with stale_revision and the current revision to retry with. Ops that target no clip (timeline/track/settings/asset mutations) only require the revision to be a known bundle_version — best-effort under concurrency, per-clip collisions are the Tier-1 scope

media_root.description: Optional absolute directory containing every file, registered as the media root level (reused when already registered); files under a deeper registered root keep that root. Does not grant access: the directory must already be inside the allowed area, so grant a new volume with media.add_media_root first

path.description: Absolute path to the media file to register (not a .wiz bundle)

require_exact_revision.description: When true, expect_revision must equal the current autosave bundle_version exactly. This opts snapshot-derived multicam publication out of the default per-clip/disjoint-edit semantics

clip_id.description: Clip id; omit for the timeline graph

channel.description: Alpha reads source transparency; luma derives coverage from source RGB.
